Hammersmith & City Railway opened 13 Jun 1864 (with the GWR); run as part of the Metropolitan line until given its own identity (CULG: 30 Jul 1990 in the introduction, 30 Jul 1989 in the table). Uses 1863 Metropolitan Railway tracks Paddington–Farringdon. Ran to Richmond over the LSWR 1877–1906 and on the Kensington (Olympia) branch 1864–1940. Barking via the District since 1936 (gap during WWII, resumed 6 Oct 1941).

Stanmore branch (1932, Metropolitan) and Bakerloo's Baker Street–Stanmore section transferred to the Jubilee on 1 May 1979. Charing Cross terminus closed after 19 Nov 1999 when the Jubilee Line Extension was linked in.
